draft.subject: Following up on your SSO question
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for your patience on the SSO question from your IT team 
invite is still open on our side, and I'm keeping an eye on it. To confirm what I shared earlier: SSO is available on the Team plan. I'm happy to pass your IT team's questions along so you get a clear answer in one go.

In the meantime, your first project in Wrenfield is set up, and the next step that usually makes it click is getting your team's actual tasks and people in there. Teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
